note: Shared sign glossary for every Egyptian text; keys are Gardiner codes. The reader embeds an identical copy (SIGN_GLOSSARIES). Add signs only with .github/pipeline/run3/signs.py.

M17.name: flowering reed
M17.pron: 'i'/'y' or glottal stop (written i here; Leiden j)

A1.name: seated man
A1.sound: 1sg suffix pronoun ·i; det. of a man
A1.determines: a man; a person; 1st person ('I/me'); occupations & roles

D54.name: walking legs
D54.determines: motion — verbs of coming, going, movement

Z1.name: single stroke
Z1.determines: logogram/ideogram marker (the sign IS the word); the number 'one'

Z2.name: plural strokes
Z2.determines: plurality — a plural or collective noun

O49.name: town (crossroads)
O49.determines: a town, city, or place; a settlement

D4.name: eye
D4.determines: the eye; seeing; (as verb) do, make

G37.name: sparrow (small bird)
G37.determines: bad, evil, small, weak — abstract negatives

A2.name: man with hand to mouth
A2.determines: eat, drink, speak, think, feel; effort — actions of mouth or mind

A14.name: man with blood streaming from his head
A14.determines: death, dying; an enemy; the dead

A40.name: seated god
A40.determines: a god; a divine being (classifies divine names)

A58.name: standing man
A58.determines: a man; a male person; human action

Aa8.name: irrigation district / canal-land sign
Aa8.determines: a region or district; irrigated land (reading here uncertain)

F27.name: hide of a mammal, with tail

H6.name: feather (Shu / feather of Maꜥat)
H6.determines: the feather of Maꜥat; truth, rightness; air

H8.name: egg
H8.determines: egg; a goddess or woman; a son; birth

I14.name: serpent
I14.determines: a snake or serpent; a serpent-deity

N5.name: sun disk
N5.determines: the sun; a day; time; the sun-god

N21.name: tongue of land / estate
N21.determines: a strip of land; an estate; a region

N25.name: range of three hills (desert)
N25.determines: hill-country, desert; a foreign land; the necropolis

N35a.name: ripples of water (canal)
N35a.determines: water, liquid; a body of water

R14.name: emblem of the West (feather on standard)
R14.determines: the West; the western land of the dead

Z15g.name: group of small strokes (numeral variant)
Z15g.determines: strokes accompanying a sign-group (function here uncertain)

A30.name: man with arms raised in adoration

A51.name: squatting noble in a robe
A51.determines: a noble, a dignitary, honoured persons

A52.name: squatting noble with flail
A52.determines: a noble; a dignitary; honoured persons

Aa13.name: uncertain object (one of Gardiner's 'half' signs, Aa13–Aa15)

Aa15.name: uncertain object (a variant of Aa13)
Aa15.sound: im, m (often writing the preposition m)

Aa19.name: unidentified object
Aa19.determines: a few words of the root ḥr ('be ready'; 'terror')

I6.name: piece of crocodile skin with spines

P1.name: boat
P1.determines: boats, ships; sailing, travel by water

V29.name: swab made of a twisted piece of fibre

W17.name: four water jars in a rack

Z9.name: two crossed sticks
Z9.determines: crossing, breaking, dividing, counting (as in ḥsb, swꜣ, sḏ, wpi)

A21.name: man holding a staff and a cloth (official)

A28.name: man with both arms raised
A28.determines: height; raising; also exultation or lament

A47.name: herdsman seated in a mantle, holding a stick

A9.name: man carrying a basket on his head

Aa21.name: uncertain object (Gardiner Aa21)
Aa21.sound: wḏꜥ 'judge, separate'; also writes the god Seth (stẖ)

D41.name: forearm with palm down
D41.determines: actions of the arm: reaching, giving, taking

M15.name: clump of papyrus with buds bent down

M24.name: plant on a mouth sign (sedge of the South)

M6.name: plant (uncertain; Gardiner M6)
M6.sound: tr (in tr 'season, time'); also r in some writings

O9.name: enclosure with a basket on it

R22.name: emblem of the god Min (two belemnites?)

W10.name: cup
W10.sound: iꜥb (also wsḫ, ḥnt in some words)

W15.name: water jar with water pouring out

C11.name: god Heh with arms raised, palm rib on his head
C11.determines: the god Heh; millions; infinity, eternity

L2.name: bee
L2.sound: bit (bee; in bity 'king of Lower Egypt')
L2.determines: bees; honey; the king of Lower Egypt (in bity)

N33a.name: three grains of sand (pellets)
N33a.determines: sand; minerals; powders and medicaments (plural of N33)

A26.name: man with one arm raised, calling

A50.name: noble seated on a chair
A50.determines: revered person, the dead (e.g. šps 'noble'; also ideogram šps)

A53.name: standing mummy
A53.determines: likeness, form, statue, mummy (e.g. twt 'image', qi 'form', sꜥḥ 'mummy')

F9.name: head and neck of a leopard

M22.name: rush with shoots
M22.determines: doubled (M22 M22) it is often read nn

N28.name: rays of the sun over a hill

O42.name: fence
O42.determines: also read šsp; in šsp 'receive' and šspt 'chapel'

P3.name: sacred barque
P3.determines: sacred barque, ships of the gods, sail (e.g. wiꜣ 'barque', ꜥḏt / mꜥnḏt and msktt the day and night barks)

R7.name: bowl with smoke rising
R7.determines: incense (sntr); also used for nṯr 'god' in some writings

U23.name: chisel
U23.determines: also mr; in ꜣbḏw 'Abydos / the abdju-fish', ꜣb 'stop, be pure'

W25.name: pot with legs
W25.determines: bring (ini); the preposition in 'by' is written with it

A42.name: king with uraeus, holding the flail

A45.name: king wearing the red crown, holding the flail
A45.determines: the king of Lower Egypt; a ruler

F12.name: head and neck of a canine

F16.name: horn
F16.sound: ꜥb "horn"; also used for other sounds in some words

F40.name: backbone with spinal cord at both ends

P2.name: ship under sail
P2.determines: sailing upstream (south, with the wind); ships

R17.name: wig on a pole with fillet and plumes (fetish of Abydos)
R17.determines: the region and cult of Abydos

Aa30.name: frieze ornament (ḫkr)
Aa30.determines: in ḫkr "adorn, ornament"; sometimes used for ḫ in other words

E17.name: jackal
E17.determines: also logogram for sꜣb "jackal; dignitary"; determinative of jackal-gods

G53.name: human-headed bird (ba) before an incense bowl
G53.determines: the ba, the soul as a free-moving form of the dead

K5.name: fish (Petrocephalus)
K5.determines: fish; things that stink or are abhorred (also read bs)

U35.name: spindle with horned viper
U35.determines: ligature of U34 ḫsf and the viper f, in ḫsf "oppose, repel"

A54.name: recumbent mummy
A54.determines: death, burial, lying in state (e.g. qrs "bury", sḏr "lie")

D29.name: two arms raised (ka) on a standard
D29.sound: kꜣ (the ka-sign set on a standard; ideogram "ka, spirit")

U39.name: post of a balance
U39.sound: wṯs, ṯs "lift, raise" (the upright of the scales)

A7.name: man sinking down, weary
A7.determines: weariness, weakness, being slack (e.g. wrd "be weary", bꜣgi "be slack")

D3.name: hair
D3.determines: hair, being bald or bereft; mourning (e.g. iꜣkb "mourn"); colour

N11.name: crescent moon
N11.determines: the moon; months and lunar feasts

Z15e.name: six vertical strokes
Z15e.determines: the number six (sjs); also writes the name of the sixth-day feast (snwt)

Aa16.name: short form of the side / half sign (Aa13)
Aa16.determines: half, side; also used for m in some groups and as an unread sign in a few words

O40.name: stairway (flight of steps)
O40.determines: stairs, steps, terraces, raised places (ḫtyw, rwd)

X2.name: tall loaf of bread
X2.determines: bread and cakes (tꜣ, t-ḥḏ); also t as a variant of X1

P11.name: mooring post
P11.determines: mooring, landing; (of the dead) dying (e.g. mni "moor")

D26.name: liquid issuing from lips
D26.determines: spitting, vomiting, and what issues from the body (e.g. psg "spit", snf "blood")

S9.name: two plumes
S9.determines: the double plume (šwty), crown of Amun and Min

V10.name: cartouche (ring of rope)
V10.determines: royal names written inside it; encircling (šnw "circuit")

Aa5.name: part of a ship's steering gear (?)

W16.name: water pouring from a jar on a stand

Aa18.name: back or side of something (uncertain object)

D57.name: leg with a knife across it

E32.name: seated baboon
E32.determines: baboon, ape; also used for Thoth and for anger (knd)

M42.name: flower (wn)
M42.sound: wn (a variant of E34 the hare in wn "be, exist")

F3.name: head of a hippopotamus
F3.determines: logogram in ꜣt "moment, instant"; phonetic ꜣt

M4.name: palm rib (stripped palm branch)
M4.determines: logogram in rnpt "year"; phonetic rnp (rnpi "be young")

F42.name: rib
F42.determines: logogram in spr "rib"; phonetic spr in spr "arrive, reach"

T13.name: two pieces of wood lashed together
T13.determines: phonetic rs in rs "be watchful, wake"

T26.name: bird-trap
T26.determines: phonetic sḫt in sḫt "trap, weave" and related words

Z15B.name: three vertical strokes
Z15B.determines: the number three (ḫmt); with t the ordinal "third"

Z3A.name: three plural strokes (horizontal arrangement)
Z3A.determines: plurality, a variant arrangement of the plural strokes

A19.name: bent man leaning on a stick
A19.determines: old age and the old (iꜣw "old man, old age", smsw "eldest"); also the chief, the great one

I3.name: crocodile
I3.determines: the crocodile (msḥ), and greed and aggression (ꜣd "be aggressive")

T19.name: harpoon head of bone
T19.determines: bone and things made of bone (qs "bone")

Z15A.name: two vertical strokes
Z15A.determines: the number two (snw); with nw the ordinal "second"

Z15c.name: four vertical strokes
Z15c.determines: the number four (fdw); with nw or t the ordinal "fourth"

Z15d.name: five vertical strokes
Z15d.determines: the number five (diw); with nw or t the ordinal "fifth"

O16.name: gateway surmounted by a frieze of uraei
O16.determines: gateways and portals (sbḫt "pylon, portal"), often with the house O1

N9.name: moon with its lower half obscured
N9.determines: psḏntyw, the feast of the new moon

Aa20.name: bag of linen / bundle of clothing (?)

A13.name: kneeling man with arms bound behind him (captive)

A55.name: mummy lying on a bed
A55.determines: lie down; sleep; death; the dead

E16.name: recumbent jackal on a shrine
E16.sound: inpw (Anubis); also in titles of Anubis

N34.name: ingot of metal
N34.determines: copper, bronze and things made of metal

H5.name: wing
H5.determines: wings; flying; (in some words) gathering, spreading over

Z4A.name: two upright strokes
Z4A.pron: y (a variant of the pair of oblique strokes)
Z4A.determines: dual; a variant of the pair of strokes Z4, used for y and as a dual or repetition mark (as in sp sn "twice")

C4.name: seated god with ram head
C4.determines: the ram-headed god Khnum (and other ram-headed gods); logogram for the name of Khnum

G7.name: falcon on a standard
G7.determines: gods and divine beings (a divine-name classifier); also the king

E25.name: hippopotamus
E25.determines: the hippopotamus; also used in writing a few words with ꜣ (as ꜣt "moment")

D49.name: fist grasping
D49.determines: grasping, seizing, holding; also used for the arm with a held object in some words (as sꜣq "gather")

W20.name: milk jug with cover / carrying net
W20.determines: milk (irṯt) and other liquids kept in jugs

A5.name: crouching man hidden behind a wall

E18.name: recumbent jackal on a standard
E18.determines: the jackal gods of the standard, above all Wepwawet (wp-wꜣwt "Opener of the Ways")

F44.name: leg-bone with meat
F44.determines: the thigh, the leg of meat; heir and inheritance (iwꜥ)

G6.name: falcon with flail
G6.determines: Horus and other falcon gods; a divine-name classifier

D55.name: walking legs moving backward
D55.determines: going back, turning back, retreat (ꜥnn "turn back", ḥm "retreat"); sometimes for going out

O10.name: falcon within an enclosure
O10.determines: writes the name of the goddess Hathor ("House of Horus")

S20.name: seal on a necklace
S20.determines: seals and sealing; shutting, closing in (ḫtm "seal, shut")

Z5.name: diagonal stroke
Z5.determines: hieratic substitute for a sign too complex or awkward to draw; also replaces a determinative

T9.name: bow
T9.sound: pd (as in pḏt "bow"); also logogram for the bow

A33.name: man with stick and bundle on shoulder (wanderer, herdsman)

O51.name: pile of grain on a mud floor (granary)

R13.name: falcon and feather on a standard (emblem of the West)

U16.name: sledge with jackal head, with load
